salient_features_li2: Designed to formulate authentication standards and develop pluggable authentication components for seamless user onboarding and authentication.

salient_features_li4: Integrated with multiple backend verification parameters including Aadhaar Card, Pan Card, Driving License, Application dependent Id and others.

override_text:
JanParichay is a single sign on platform which act as One digital identity for all applications.
Override the hassles of multiple login credentials for the various citizen-centric government services along with an added layer of security by providing a strong authentication mechanism
Ans1: Jan Parichay is a Single Sign On Platform for Government to Citizen (G2C) serviceslike transport applications, MyGov and others. Jan Parichay authenticates the user for all the services and does authorization) based on the rights given to the user, so it eliminates further need of authentication/authorization when the user switches services during the same session.
Ques2: What is a Single Sign On Platform?
Ans2: Single sign-on (SSO) is a centralized session and user authentication service in which a set of login credentials can be used to access multiple applications. This offers major benefits for the users as it eliminates the need to repeatedly prove their identities to different applications and hold different credentials for each application.
Ques3: What are the benefits of using Jan Parichay?
Ans3: The basic objective of Jan Parichay is to eliminate individual sign-on procedures by centralizing user authentication and identity management at a central identity provider. It enhances security of user credentials, increases user productivity as it allows user mobility and access to multiple services and applications by authenticating just once.
Ques4: How can I join Jan Parichay?
Ans4: Jan Parichay provides a Registration module for citizens that allows a user to register using any verification parameters that includes their E-mail/ Mobile/Government Ids such as PAN, Aadhaar Card, Driving License, Voter ID, etc., hence,the user on-boarding is quick and uniform.
Ques5: Is it safe to share Aadhar Card details with Jan Parichay?
Ans5: Yes, it is completely safe as Jan Parichay is highly secured with the AES algorithm. Jan Parichay stores all the verification parameter details as an encrypted string.
Ques6: Can I login with my linked verification Ids?
Ans6: Yes, Jan Parichay provides flexible login. You can login with user ID or any of the linked verification IDs like mobile number, E-mail ID etc.
Ques7: What is the login process for Jan Parichay?
Ans7: One can login using E-mail ID or mobile number by using the password generated while registration. On successful authentication, 2 step multi factor authentication is performed as well. On successful 2FA, a user is able to login.
Ans8: One of the most secure prevention controls for unauthorized access, fraud, and cyber identity thefts is two-step multifactor authentication. This adds an additional layer of security, in which a user authenticates by providing a password, as well as a second factor, that could be an OTP (sent over registered mobile number or E-mail ID), Backup Code, Token or Tap Authentication method.
Ques9: How can I contact the Jan Parichay team in case of any query/complaint?
Ans9: User can register their complaint via support-parichay[at]nic[dot]in or call on toll free number 1800-111-555.
Ques10: How can I send my feedbacks to the Jan Parichay team?
Ans10: User Can E-mail on support-parichay[at]nic[dot]in or call on toll free number 1800-111-555.
Ques11: When does my session expire on Jan Parichay and what will be the impact of session expiry?
Ans11: Each application based on its criticality may have different session idle timeout. Jan Parichay allows the application to manage their session idle timeout as per their application need. User will need to authenticate again to get access to the application that has been timed out, however, continue to access other applications with valid session without further authentication.By default, Jan Parichay session expiry time is of 12 hours and user will be logged out of all the application on its expiry and will be asked to login again.

Ques24: Why is the Text-to-Speech (TTS) option with Hindi Language not working on my JanParichay application?
ans24: The Hindi Text-to-Speech feature in the JanParichay application relies on your computer's built-in language support. By default, both Windows and macOS only support English TTS voices. To enable Hindi TTS functionality, you need to install or enable the Hindi language pack on your system.
follow_steps: Follow these simple steps to enable Hindi TTS:
click_language: Click on “Add a language” and search for “Hindi”.
select_hindi: Select Hindi and click Next → Ensure Text-to-Speech and Speech recognition options are checked.
click_install: Click Install and allow the system to download and apply the changes.
open_sys_setting: Open System Settings → Navigate to Accessibility → Select Spoken Content.
scroll_hindi: Scroll to find Hindi in the voice list.
check_box_hindi: Check the box next to Hindi voice (e.g., 'Lekha') and click OK to download it.
after_install: After installation, set the system voice to Hindi for use in JanParichay.
once_done_reload: Once this is done, reload the JanParichay web page and try using Text-to-Speech option with Hindi Language again.

faq2: What is a Single Sign On Platform?
faq2_ans: Single sign-on (SSO) is a centralized session and user authentication service in which a set of login credentials can be used to access multiple applications. This offers major benefits for the users as it eliminates the need to repeatedly prove their identities to different applications and hold different credentials for each application.
faq3: What are the benefits of using Jan Parichay?
faq3_ans: The basic objective of Jan Parichay is to eliminate individual sign-on procedures by centralizing user authentication and identity management at a central identity provider. It enhances security of user credentials, increases user productivity as it allows user mobility and access to multiple services and applications by authenticating just once.

about_intro_paragraph_1: JanParichay is a single sign-on application designed to integrate services under a single authentication domain. It is a centralized session and user authentication service in which one set of login credentials can be used to access multiple applications. The service authenticates user one on one designated platform, enabling the user to use a plethora of services without having to log in and logout each time.
about_intro_paragraph_2: The sole purpose of the application is to provide SSO framework for the various Government services along with an added layer of security by providing a strong authentication mechanism.
about_salient_feature_1: Provides e-Authentication as a service to government departments for providing a secure and convenient way for users to access government services as well as for the government departments to assess the authenticity of the users.
about_salient_feature_2: Designed to formulate authentication standards and develop pluggable authentication components for seamless user onboarding and authentication.
about_salient_feature_3: Authenticates the user for all the services and does authorization based on the service enforced verification parameters.
about_salient_feature_4: Integrated with multiple backend verification parameters including Aadhaar Card, Pan Card, Driving License, Application dependent Id and others.
about_salient_feature_5: Allows user as well as integrated service to enforce multi-factor authentication including OTP, Backup Codes, Tap and Token.
about_salient_feature_6: Offers Real-time analytics capabilities via JanParichay Analytics application, which help to identify a user session activity thus reducing potential profile hacks.
about_salient_feature_7: Extended to any number of user bases but restricted to the size of the backend infrastructure cluster.
about_feature_desc_multifactor_auth: By using Parichay Authenticator, users can enable multiple-factor authentication to login Parichay via Tap, and Token Authentication.
about_feature_desc_standard_integration: Application owners can opt for various integration methods to integrate their application with Parichay i.e. Rest APIs, SAML 2.0, and OAuth 2.0 .
about_feature_desc_realtime_analytics: An analytical dashboard to track user activities and reduce suspicious actions.
about_feature_desc_geofencing: Users can restrict their individual access for specific locations by enabling the virtual boundaries.
about_feature_desc_multilingual: The platform offers multiple language support to meet the diverse understanding of the users PAN India.

faq_q4: 4. How can I join Jan Parichay?
faq_a4: Jan Parichay provides a Registration module for citizens that allows a user to register using any verification parameters that includes their E-mail/Mobile/Government Ids such as PAN, Aadhaar Card, Driving License, Voter ID, etc., hence, the user on-boarding is quick and uniform.
faq_q5: 5. Is it safe to share Aadhar Card details with Jan Parichay?
faq_a5: Yes, it is completely safe as Jan Parichay is highly secured with the AES algorithm. Jan Parichay stores all the verification parameter details as an encrypted string.
faq_q6: 6. Can I login with my linked verification Ids?
faq_a6: Yes, Jan Parichay provides flexible login. You can login with user ID or any of the linked verification IDs like mobile number, E-mail ID etc.
faq_q7: 7. What is the login process for Jan Parichay?
faq_a7: One can login using E-mail ID or mobile number by using the password generated while registration. On successful authentication, 2 step multi factor authentication is performed as well. On successful 2FA, a user is able to login.
faq_a8: One of the most secure prevention controls for unauthorized access, fraud, and cyber identity thefts is two-step multifactor authentication. This adds an additional layer of security, in which a user authenticates by providing a password, as well as a second factor, that could be an OTP (sent over registered mobile number or E-mail ID), Backup Code, Token or Tap Authentication method.
faq_q9: 9. How can I contact the Jan Parichay team in case of any query/complaint?
faq_a9: User can register their complaint via support-parichay[at]nic[dot]in or call on toll free number 1800-111-555.
faq_q10: 10. How can I send my feedbacks to the Jan Parichay team?
faq_a10: User Can E-mail on support-parichay[at]nic[dot]in or call on toll free number 1800-111-555.
faq_q11: 11. When does my session expire on Jan Parichay and what will be the impact of session expiry?
faq_a11: Each application based on its criticality may have different session idle timeout. Jan Parichay allows the application to manage their session idle timeout as per their application need. User will need to authenticate again to get access to the application that has been timed out, however, continue to access other applications with valid session without further authentication. By default, Jan Parichay session expiry time is of 12 hours and user will be logged out of all the application on its expiry and will be asked to login again.
faq_q12: 12. I am unable to register with my mobile number.
faq_a12_item_1: If you are not able to get SMS of OTP
faq_a12_item_2: If you are getting any error message, please contact Jan Parichay Support.
faq_q13: 13. I am getting 'Service Not Found' error on the Jan Parichay login page.
faq_a13_item_1: Contact the service owner and check if the service is registered with Jan Parichay or not.
faq_a13_item_2: The service owner list can be found based on service name. For list, contact Jan Parichay Support.
faq_q14: 14. Even after successful login to the Jan Parichay application, I am getting 'user is not authorized to access the service' while accessing certain services.?
faq_a14: You are not allowed to access the respective service. Please contact the service owner.
faq_q15: 15. I am not receiving OTP on my mobile number.
faq_a15_item_1: Kindly verify your registered mobile number
faq_a15_item_2: If mobile number is correct, please check if the OTP is received on registered E-mail or not
faq_a15_item_3: If OTP is received on registered E-mail, then there might be some problem with the mobile network
faq_a15_item_4: If OTP is not received on registered E-mail, please contact Jan Parichay Support.
faq_q16: 16. I am being asked to perform 2 step multi factor authentication on every login.
faq_a16_item_1: When you login, you may remember the known environment with JanParichay. Click on 'Remember My Device' to remember your device/ environment.
faq_a16_item_2: If any of the parameters (IP, Browser ID, or OS) changes, you will get the OTP.
faq_q17: 17. I am being asked for password frequently on other integrated services.
faq_a17_item_1: Certain services may maintain their session timeout differently
faq_a17_item_2: If session is idle for that time (session timeout), you will be asked to enter password again to login back to the respective service.
faq_q18: 18. How can I see all the devices logged into my Jan Parichay account?
faq_a18_item_2: Go to Settings -> Activity -> User Devices
faq_a18_item_3: Here the device details can be accessed like Device Name, IP Name, Time of Login and Logout
faq_a18_item_4: For more information about device activities, please visit https://analytics.gov.in
faq_q19: 19. How can I see all the active sessions logged into my Jan Parichay account?
faq_a19_item_2: Go to Settings -> AccountActivity -> Recent Activities
faq_a19_item_3: For more information about session activities, please visit https://analytics.gov.in
faq_q20: 20. While accessing Jan Parichay integrated services, I am getting an error with the message: 'Data Integrity Lost'.
faq_a20_intro: Data Integrity Lost error usually pops up when the Client Application time is not synced with the Standard Time Zone. In that case, kindly follow the solution mentioned below:
faq_a20_item_1: Report this issue to the Client Application Owner
faq_a20_item_2: You may approach the Support team (support-parichay[at]nic[dot]in)
faq_q21: 21. While accessing Jan Parichay integrated services, I am getting an error with the message: 'Access Denied'.
faq_a21_item_1: You are not authorized to access the client application, kindly contact the concerned Service Owner.
faq_a21_item_2: However, you can access the Jan Parichay dashboard.
faq_q22: 22. How can I reactivate my JanParichay-Meri Pehchaan Account?

policies_social_login_bullet_2: JanParichay uses user's personal data only for authentication purposes to facilitate login for users. You are informed of the data that JanParichay shares with the third party. JanParichay does not share user details without your permission.
policies_pw_overview_desc: All users that have access to the Jan Parichay website must adhere to the password policies defined below in order to protect the security of the website, and protect data integrity.
policies_pw_scope_desc: This policy applies to any and all users who have any form of website account requiring a password.
policies_pw_requirement_3: Minimum complexity - No dictionary words included.
policies_pw_requirement_4: Must contain both upper (A-Z) and lower case (a-z) character.
policies_pw_requirement_5: Must include minimum of a numeric character (0-9) and special character (~! @#$%^&*_-+=`|\(){}[]:;"'< >,?.?/)
policies_pw_requirement_6: System generated password must be changed before accessing the website.
policies_pw_protection_2: Never send a password through email.
policies_pw_protection_3: Never include a password in a non-encrypted stored document.
policies_pw_protection_5: Never reveal your password over the telephone.
policies_pw_protection_6: Never hint at the format of your password.
policies_pw_protection_7: Never reveal or hint at your password on a form on the internet.
policies_pw_protection_8: Never choose 'Remember Password' feature on public devices.
policies_pw_protection_9: Don't use common acronyms as part of your password.
policies_pw_protection_10: Don't use common words or reverse spelling of words in part of your password.
policies_pw_protection_11: Don't use names of people or places as part of your password.
policies_pw_protection_12: Don't use part of your login name in your password.
policies_pw_protection_13: Don't use parts of numbers easily remembered such as phone numbers, social security numbers, or street addresses.
policies_data_protection_desc: This Privacy Policy shall govern the collection, use, and management of users' personal and usage information by Jan Parichay, in accordance with the applicable laws of India.
policies_data_protection_bullet_1: To use the Jan Parichay services, user has to register himself at Jan Parichay with some mandatory fields - Full Name, Mobile Number, Gender and Date of birth. User may also link Aadhaar as a part of E-KYC for authentication purpose.
policies_data_protection_bullet_2: Jan Parichay does not share/ disclose any information including eKYC details of the user collected from Aadhaar at the time of sign up with any individual unless and until it is authorized by the account holder with his/her consent.
policies_data_protection_bullet_3: Jan Parichay Portal collects information such as Internet Protocol (IP) Addresses, Browser type, Operating System, location, login Date and Time etc. To add the transparency, these details are available at Jan Parichay dashboard and user can view this login activity in case they feel any suspicious activity related to their account.
policies_data_protection_bullet_4: The user's consent shall be specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguously, expressed through a clear affirmative action. It shall indicate agreement for the processing of his/her personal data solely for the specified purpose and shall be limited to only such personal data as is necessary for that purpose.
policies_data_protection_bullet_5: Jan Parichay uses cookies to record current session information and enhance the overall user experience. Users may manage or block cookies through their browser settings or other available tools; however, blocking cookies may interrupt or discontinue the Jan Parichay session.
policies_data_protection_bullet_6: Jan Parichay neither shares nor discloses any information—including eKYC details obtained from Aadhaar during account registration (optional).
policies_nested_intro: The personal and usage information collected may be shared with other Government organizations if the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, in good faith, determines that the access, use, preservation, or disclosure of such information is reasonably necessary to:
policies_nested_bullet_1: Comply with applicable laws, regulations, legal processes, or enforceable government requests;
policies_nested_bullet_2: Detect, prevent, or address fraud, security or technical issues, and investigate potential violations; or
policies_nested_bullet_3: Protect the rights, property, or safety of the Jan Parichay, its users, or the public, as required or permitted by law.
